developerInstruction: This is an Axiom in-session routing evaluation. Every turn ends with the structured routing observation for that turn's request. A turn whose request begins with [routing-observation] is a measured turn: select the Axiom route or routes that the request after the marker would invoke, and do not carry it out. Every other turn is a setup turn: carry it out with read-only means inside this workspace before reporting its own observation. No turn grants mutation authority: do not edit files, use credentials, contact external services, or request approval. Return no prose inside the structured output.

files.README.md:
# Ledger Sync

Ledger Sync is a small command-line tool that reconciles two CSV exports of the same account and prints the rows that differ. It has no network access and writes nothing outside the output directory you name.

## Layout

- `sync.py`: the reconciliation script
- `config.toml`: column mapping and the output directory
- `CHANGELOG.md`: release history

turnFacts.setup: turn completed; tool-capable read-only items are allowed; no file change, approval request, or external action; the structured output validates against the bound schema and its selectedRoutes are counted as a setup-turn selection, not judged against a case
turnFacts.non-request: turn completed; tool-capable items are allowed and not required; no file change, approval request, or external action; the structured output validates and its selectedRoutes are counted as a non-request-turn selection, where any route is a false positive by the gate's requests-only rule
turnFacts.compact: the host's compaction item or compacted notification is observed before the next turn starts; a startup-hook re-delivery for the compaction source is recorded when the host emits one
turnFacts.measured: turn completed; no tool-capable item; structured output validates against the bound schema with routingGateObserved true and false mutation fields; selectedRoutes and clarificationCount are judged against the corpus case

measurement.comparison: per family and per route, counts of measured turns whose routes match the corpus case, against the fresh family of the same run; a condition is named when a family routes fewer positives or leaves fewer controls host-native than the fresh family, and the named count is the confirmed one
measurement.publication: counts only; raw streams, transcripts, and workspace contents stay private and no public result record is produced

hostMechanics.session: codex app-server: thread/start with the fixture workspace as cwd, the model, a read-only sandbox, approval policy never, this developer instruction, and startup as the session source; the plugin is installed from a local marketplace into an isolated home whose configuration records trust for the packaged SessionStart hook, and the thread/start result names no instruction source
hostMechanics.turn: turn/start with one text input item, the profile's reasoning effort, and the bound response schema as outputSchema on every turn; the turn ends at turn/completed
hostMechanics.compaction: thread/compact/start on the same thread; the host records a contextCompaction item and re-runs the plugin SessionStart hook on the next turn
hostMechanics.tools: default tools kept; web search disabled in configuration
